confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kerala hill-station prices, not from live listings or current menus. Restaurant meal anchors are moderately reliable. Beer and wine are least certain because Munnar has few licensed venues and alcohol prices vary widely. Accommodation assumes a July monsoon, off-peak window and may vary. The FX observation comes from search results that summarise the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page or F11.1 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Kerala and other southern Western Ghats hill-station towns (e.g. Kodaikanal, Ooty) with similar rupee price levels and tourism demand. Cocktail is set at about 2x the beer anchor and wine_glass at a premium to cocktail, because direct knowledge of bar and restaurant alcohol prices is weak and imported wine carries high duties.
